description: This Java class 'BitmapHelper' provides utility methods for handling bitmaps, including scaling images to specified dimensions, calculating scale factors, and fetching and rescaling bitmaps from a URL.

classes.name: BitmapHelper
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for bitmap manipulation, including scaling and fetching images from URLs.

methods.name: scaleBitmap
methods.description: Scales the provided bitmap to fit within maximum width and height constraints while maintaining aspect ratio.

methods.name: scaleBitmap
methods.description: Decodes an InputStream into a scaled bitmap based on the specified scale factor.

methods.name: findScaleFactor
methods.description: Calculates the optimal scale factor to resize an image from InputStream so that it fits within target width and height.

methods.name: fetchAndRescaleBitmap
methods.description: Fetches an image from a URL, determines the scale factor needed for the desired size, and returns the scaled bitmap.
